def node.ApplyConfChange.spec : Prop :=
  ∀ (n : Loc) (γ : Cluster) (N : Namespace) (id : w64) (c : GoInterface) (o o' : ConfChangeIM) (l : List LogEntry)
    (k : Nat) (e : LogEntry) (v : ConfigView) (m' : Membership),
    v.applied ≤ k →
      l[k]? = some e →
        e.isConfChange →
          Membership.applyChange o' v.membership = some m' →
            Membership.applyChange o v.membership = some m' →
              ⊢
                ∀ Φ,
                  isPkgInit pkg_id.go_etcd_io.raft.v3 ∗
                      isNode n γ N id ∗
                        isCluster γ N ∗
                          confDecided γ k (ConfDecision.apply o') ∗
                            ownConfChangeI c DFrac.discard (some o) ∗
                              nodeConfig n γ N v ∗ deliveredLogLb n γ N l ∗ skippedIn γ l v.applied k -∗
                    (▷
                        ∀ csp cs,
                          csPts csp (DFrac.own 1) cs true ∗
                                nodeConfig n γ N { applied := k + 1, membership := m' } ∗ ⌜confStateIs cs m'⌝ ∨
                              ⌜csp = null⌝ ∗ nodeStopped n γ N -∗
                            Φ (intoVal csp)) -∗
                      WP
                        ((intoVal
                            (methods node.ty.PointerType
                              go!"ApplyConfChange"
                              (intoVal n)))
                          (intoVal c))
                        {{ Φ }}
